result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where delivery time and delivery fee text overlap on a restaurant card.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25-35 min') and delivery cost ('€0 delivery') text strings are overlapping, making both unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Use a proper flex or inline layout with spacing and a separator (such as a bullet point) so that the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine category render sequentially without colliding.
